description: This source file implements the `LocalVersionHolder` class, which manages a local version state, including initialization and comparison with a global version.

classes.name: LocalVersionHolder
classes.description: A class that maintains a local version state and provides methods to retrieve and update the version.

methods.name: LocalVersionHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the local version to -1, indicating an 'old' version on instantiation.

methods.name: isOld
methods.description: Checks if a given global version is newer than the local version; updates the local version if so and returns true.
